drafts.dj_story_text: November twenty-fourth, nineteen seventy-three. Ringo Starr reached number one in America with Photograph, written with George Harrison. His first solo American chart-topper brought two former Beatles together behind an instantly memorable song. Sometimes a photograph holds a memory; this one became a record.
drafts.on_screen_story: Photograph became Ringo Starr's first US number one, written with George Harrison.

drafts.dj_story_text: November twenty-fifth, nineteen ninety-five. Whitney Houston reached number one in America with Exhale, the Babyface song from Waiting to Exhale. It became her eleventh American chart-topper. That gentle chorus needed a few syllables, but Whitney gave them all the feeling a song needs.
drafts.on_screen_story: Exhale (Shoop Shoop), written by Babyface, became Whitney Houston's eleventh US number one.
